blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Public Works and Highways Secretary Vince Dizon reported on Friday that there are no ghost projects in Taguig City. His statement affirmed the assertions of Senate Minority Leader Alan Peter Cayetano. During the Senate finance subcommittee’s hearing on the budget of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH), Cayetano asked Dizon on the status of the agency’s investigation on Taguig infrastructure projects. “Are there any ghost projects in Taguig?” Cayetano asked. In response, Dizon said: “None. In our investigation, none.” READ: Lacson: P3.7B ‘wasted’ in Taguig reclamation Dizon noted that the investigations on flood control projects nationwide […]...
